% The blue function's two samples (-2,1), (1,10) and their chord miss
% the frame. The corner at (1,1) must still enter from the left and exit
% through the top. For the red jump plot only y=.5 and 3.5 are visible.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=4cm,height=6cm,scale only axis,axis lines=box,
      xmin=0,xmax=4,ymin=0,ymax=6,enlargelimits=false,clip=true,ticks=none]
    \addplot[blue,thick,const plot,domain=-2:1,samples=2,mark=none] {3*x+7};
    \addplot[red,thick,jump mark mid,domain=-1:5,samples=3,mark=none] {x+1.5};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
